description: Five compactions of one bug-fix session in dim-agent-questions; each step repeats the previous step's retained tail

messages.content:
The ask_user tool in /work/dim rejects a valid answer: when the user picks an option and then types the same text as a custom answer, a single-select question fails with "question <id> takes a single answer". Fix that in `check` in crates/dim-agent-questions/src/lib.rs.

Two constraints: don't change the ask_user tool input schema or the session.question.respond parameters, because existing clients are built against both. Keep the fix inside `check`; `parse` is not to change.

content.text: `chosen` is the bug: it counts the selected labels and the custom answer as separate choices, so when the custom text repeats the selected label a single-select question looks like two choices and gets the "takes a single answer" error. Only `respond` calls `check`; the tool input never reaches it.

messages.content: Withdraw the restriction to `check`: labels are compared in `parse` too, so change both. And fix the case handling — a client may send `Retry` where the model's label is `retry`, and `contains` rejects it. Option labels must compare ignoring ASCII case in `parse` and in `check`. Then fix the double count.

input.change: check: count a custom answer equal to a selected label once; parse and check: compare option labels ignoring ASCII case
